en.headline: Warehouse worker bitten by dog after chase by three animals in Yuen Long
en.dek: A 26-year-old man suffered a minor calf wound around 8am on Monday when one of three warehouse dogs bit him near Kam Tin Road; Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department staff took the dog for checks.
body: Police received a report about 8:01am on Monday that a 26-year-old man had been chased by three dogs near the junction of Kam Tin Road and Kam Tin West Road in Yuen Long and bitten on the left calf by one of them.
The man, a warehouse employee, sustained a small wound and was taken conscious to Pok Oi Hospital. Officers are investigating the circumstances.

The three dogs belonged to the warehouse. The one that bit him was a six-year-old female mongrel about 1.2 metres long. Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department staff later took that dog for examination.
The incident comes weeks after a fatal suspected dog attack on a woman in the same general area of Yuen Long in September, which prompted multi-agency capture operations.

zh.headline: 元朗貨倉男工被三隻倉狗追趕咬傷小腿送院
zh.dek: 周一早上約8時，26歲男倉務員在錦壐路附近被三隻狗追趕，其中一隻咬傷左小腿，傷勢輕微，漁護署人員已將涉事狗隻帶走檢查。
body: 警方今早約8時01分接獲報案，指一名26歲男子在元朗錦壐路與錦壐西路交界附近，突然被三隻狗追趕，期間被其中一隻咬傷左小腿。
事主為附近一間貨倉的倉務員，傷勢輕微，清醒被送往博愛醫院治理。警方正調查事件起因。
據了解，三隻狗為該貨倉飼養的倉狗，涉事的是一隻6歲雌性唐狗，身長約1.2米。漁農自然護理署人員其後到場將該狗帶走檢查。
事發地點一帶於今年9月曾發生懷疑狗隻襲擊女子致死案件，當時漁護署與警方展開多日聯合捕捉行動。
